summary: Lewis Hamilton confronts redemption at the Circuit of the Americas as Ferrari prodigy Kimi Antonelli closes in on a maiden world championship after capitalizing on Mercedes' Singapore miscalculation. McLaren and Red Bull shadow the title fight, their constructors' battle potentially reshaping strategy calls and fuel management across Sunday's 56 laps. An Antonelli victory would crown F1's newest champion and mathematically eliminate Hamilton's hopes of salvaging the campaign, cementing this race as the pivotal moment where the generation shift becomes official.
